one_liner: Default TypeScript app-layer AI toolkit for streamed UIs and typed tools.
best_for: Product UI streaming chat/tools on Next.js/React
when_not_to_use: Do not run AI SDK alone as a durable/compliance agent OS. ToolLoopAgent is in-memory; WorkflowAgent requires @ai-sdk/workflow. Weak native RAG platform and concurrent state control.

api_primitives.hitl: toolApproval on generateText/streamText/ToolLoopAgent; WorkflowAgent durable approval
api_primitives.checkpoint: WorkflowAgent (@ai-sdk/workflow) persists steps; ToolLoopAgent is in-memory
api_primitives.obs: telemetry API (AI SDK 7); DevTools; OTel-oriented exporters
api_primitives.multiAgent: ToolLoopAgent loops; handoffs via tools; not a graph OS
